title: Cover — BEYOND®
description: Company profile cover. CREATIVE / BEYOND® oversized type on near-black, orange accent bar, studio URL.
speakerNotes: Open strong. The dark background and orange accent immediately communicate the brand's energy. Lead with the studio name and tagline.

title: Who We Are
description: Studio overview. WHO / WE ARE split-screen with body copy describing the lean model and founding partner Guillaume Hamon.
speakerNotes: Emphasise the lean model differentiator — one founding partner, direct access, no junior work. This is a key trust signal for prospects.

title: The Belief
description: Founding philosophy. Pull quote from Guillaume Hamon on the streamlined agency model against a light background.
speakerNotes: Let the quote breathe. Pause here and let the audience read it. The manifesto sets the philosophical foundation for everything that follows.

title: Awards & Recognition
description: Giant 50+ hero stat with a breakdown of 29× Awwwards, 34× CSS Design Awards, 19× FWA, 2× Webby Awards, and LogoLounge Trends.
speakerNotes: Let the numbers do the talking. The 50+ stat is the anchor; the breakdown on the right gives specificity. These are independently verified honours.

title: Services Overview
description: FIVE / SERVICES oversized stacked type with a numbered list of all five practice areas on the right.
speakerNotes: This is the map of the whole business. Mention that slides 6–9 go deeper into each area.

title: Brand Strategy
description: BRAND / STRATEGY with tagline 'Clarity before creation.' Capabilities on left, context narrative on right with orange rule divider.
speakerNotes: Positioning, naming, and narrative are the foundation. Stress that everything we do downstream flows from this clarity.

title: Brand Identity
description: BRAND / IDENTITY with tagline 'Identity that earns attention.' Full visual identity capabilities plus narrative on outlasting trends.
speakerNotes: Mention the full-system approach — from logotype to motion to brand guidelines. We don't hand off a logo; we hand off a living system.

title: Digital Experience
description: DIGITAL / EXPERIENCE with tagline 'Websites that convert and inspire.' Tech stack capabilities and awards reference.
speakerNotes: The award record (29× Awwwards, 19× FWA) is the proof. Stress that these are production-grade builds, not design handoffs.

title: Growth & Content
description: GROWTH & / CONTENT with tagline 'Brand-led growth that compounds.' Performance and creative content capabilities.
speakerNotes: The differentiator: growth that doesn't dilute the brand. Most agencies separate brand and performance — we unify them.

title: Selected Work
description: Giant '17' projects stat with 3 continents and 50+ awards. All 17 project names listed in flowing type.
speakerNotes: This is the portfolio map. The specific case studies on slides 11–14 are the highlights; the full 17 demonstrate breadth and sector range.

title: Case Study — Clear Street
description: Dark slide. CLEAR / STREET for the 2024 capital markets fintech rebrand. WebGL globe, Klein blue palette. Awwwards SOTD + Developer Award.
speakerNotes: Clear Street was a complex fintech project — a category often associated with conservative design. Our Klein blue and WebGL execution proved otherwise.

title: Case Study — MultiversX
description: Light slide. MULTIVERS / X for the 2022 full naming and rebrand. Three-font system, sub-brand palette. Awwwards SOTD + Developer Award.
speakerNotes: We named and built the entire visual universe for MultiversX from scratch. A rare full-stack brand engagement from naming through to design system.

title: Case Study — Kōzōwood
description: Dark slide. KŌZŌ / WOOD for the 2023 CLT timber homes website. Marimba sound, WebGL, drone footage from Comporta, Portugal. Awwwards SOTD.
speakerNotes: Kōzōwood shows our range — a deeply sensory, nature-first experience using sound design, WebGL, and drone footage. One of our most awarded pieces.

title: Case Study — Floema
description: Light slide. FLO / EMA for the 2026 rebrand and website. 230 3D product models, WebGL foliage, seasonal header, CRM integration. Awwwards SOTD.
speakerNotes: Floema is our most technically ambitious project to date. 230 3D models, real-time seasonal transitions, and a fully integrated CRM — all on a consumer-facing site.

title: How We Engage
description: HOW WE / ENGAGE with two-column Sprint vs Partnership model comparison. Orange rule accent on Partnership column.
speakerNotes: Make the no-lock-in point explicit. Both models are straightforward — Sprints are fixed scope, Partnerships are month-to-month with 30 days' notice.

title: Our Process
description: OUR / PROCESS with five equal-width columns for Discovery, Strategy, Design, Build, Launch. Orange rule on Launch column.
speakerNotes: Walk through each stage briefly. Stress that every project begins with Discovery — we never skip the strategic foundation regardless of timeline.

title: Industries
description: Giant '49' sectors stat with three category columns: Tech & Digital, Consumer & Lifestyle, Professional. Orange category headings.
speakerNotes: 49 sectors demonstrates depth of experience. Use this to address any concern about industry familiarity — we've almost certainly worked in their space.

title: Let's Build
description: Dark closing slide. LET'S / BUILD. with orange full stop. Three contact blocks for New Business, Press, and Careers.
speakerNotes: End on the call to action. The three emails make the next step unambiguous. Invite them to reach out for a discovery call.
